Transcribe audio with FonadaLabs Kapture: Transcribe audio with FonadaLabs Kapture V3 (cloud). Recordings above 24 MB (MP3 or WAV) are split into chunks, transcribed with bounded concurrency, and joined in the original order.
Public or locally reachable URL for the: Public or locally reachable URL for the audio/video file. Use this when no file is mapped from a previous step.
FonadaLabs language identifier. Defaults: FonadaLabs language identifier. Defaults to en.
For recordings above 24 MB. Default 240: For recordings above 24 MB. Default 240 s (about 2.9 MB per MP3 request at 16 kHz mono 96 kbps). Accepts 30–600. Longer chunks mean fewer requests, so fewer rate-limit and upstream waits.
Chunks transcribed in parallel (1–4). De: Chunks transcribed in parallel (1–4). Default 4. The transcript is always joined in the original order. Lower it if FonadaLabs returns more 429/502 errors.
Shared pacing across all concurrent requ: Shared pacing across all concurrent requests (start to start). Default 2 s. Lower values risk HTTP 429 rate limits.
Abandon a request with no response after: Abandon a request with no response after this many seconds plus 4 s per MB uploaded (default 20 s, about 32 s for a 240 s chunk). Successful chunks normally answer in about 1 s; FonadaLabs gateway failures otherwise hang for 60 s before HTTP 502. Retried only when upstream retries are enabled.
Retry HTTP 502/503/504 and timed-out att: Retry HTTP 502/503/504 and timed-out attempts up to 6 times per chunk. Failed attempts may already be billed; enabling this can incur duplicate charges.
First wait after an upstream failure (do: First wait after an upstream failure (doubles per retry up to 120 s, ±20% jitter, shared by all concurrent requests). Default 30 s.
Stop cleanly, keeping checkpoints, befor: Stop cleanly, keeping checkpoints, before this many seconds. Default 540 s, safe for the stock 600 s host flow timeout. For long recordings set the host AP_FLOW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3600 and this to about 3300.
